rule: recorded as the exported bytes state them, at face value; nothing is selected, derived, promoted or compared to a current release to create a target range

legacy_checkpoint.interpretation: This is a legacy execution checkpoint of a June 2026 batch task. Its name, its COMPLETED flag and its timestamp do not establish a valid daily cursor and it is not bound to its writer here; NOT SELECTED AS AUTHORITATIVE.

pipeline_matrix.interpretation: A recorded pipeline matrix statement at its own as-of. Kept as metadata evidence; not a fresh serving verdict and not used to derive an increment start.

increment_rule.interpretation: The declared incremental rule with per-dataset increment classes, PIT policies and raw/clean/cache namespaces. Recorded as the rule text; no range computed from it.

raw_coverage_ledger.interpretation: A recorded RAW coverage window and its calendar authority. Not re-measured; its window is not adopted as an increment plan.
